description: This file defines a RestXmlSerializer class responsible for serializing API request payloads into XML format for AWS API interactions. It extends a base RestSerializer class and customizes payload construction with XML specific formatting.

classes.name: RestXmlSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for converting API request data into XML formatted payloads for AWS services, extending the generic RestSerializer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with the API description, endpoint, and optional XML formatter.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Builds the XML payload for a given API structure member and attaches it to the request options.

methods.name: getXmlBody
methods.description: Converts the structured data into an XML string, replacing special characters and control characters appropriately.
